sql_templates.name: fii_dii_flow_regime_breadth_today
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_trade_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows),
      flows AS (SELECT f.trade_date, f.flow_signal, f.fii_trend, f.dii_trend FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f
               JOIN latest_trade_date l ON f.trade_date = l.trade_date),
      regime AS (SELECT r.trade_date, r.regime, r.confidence FROM signals.regime_history r
                JOIN latest_trade_date l ON r.trade_date = l.trade_date),
      breadth AS (SELECT b.trade_date, b.ad_signal, b.market_sentiment FROM breadth.market_daily b
                 JOIN latest_trade_date l ON b.trade_date = l.trade_date)
SELECT flows.flow_signal, flows.fii_trend, flows.dii_trend, regime.regime, regime.confidence, breadth.ad_signal, breadth.market_sentiment 
FROM flows
JOIN regime ON flows.trade_date = regime.trade_date
JOIN breadth ON flows.trade_date = breadth.trade_date
LIMIT 5;
